Maya (Finance): Heads up: vendor promo POOL-APR-26 has 1.75M GPU-min left and expires in 5 days. We should allocate to active runs. @Omar can you list eligible scopes?

Omar (Billing): credits-bot flagged it. Eligible scopes: teams/*, benches/*, infra/temp. Note: 200k of the pool lacks cost_center tag and will be unattributed unless patched.

credits-bot: ALERT - POOL-APR-26 expiring in 5 days. Remaining: 1,750,000 GPU-min. Link: https://billing.internal/credits/POOL-APR-26

Dev (Platform): Proposal: 500k -> benches/light-eval, 900k -> infra/temp, 350k -> teams/research. Need approvals from bench owner and infra owner.

Leo (ML Eng): We can take 500k for the light-eval runs Monday-Tuesday. Please tag as cost_center=ml-eval and project=light-eval.

Maya (Finance): Approve conditional on tag patch for the 200k chunk and audit note. Justification: "use promo credits before expiry for scheduled evaluation and cluster utilization."

Omar (Billing): I'll patch missing tags (missing_cost_center=internal-temp) and schedule transfer. CLI I'll run: billingctl transfer --pool POOL-APR-26 --alloc "benches/light-eval:500000,infra/temp:900000,teams/research:350000" --apply-audit POOL-APR-26 --patch-tag missing_cost_center=internal-temp

Omar (Billing): Scheduling transfer now. JIRA FIN-POOL-762 created for tracking. TR-ID TR-APR-762 queued.

credits-bot: TRANSFER SCHEDULED TR-APR-762. Pending execution.

Dev (Platform): Please also add a 48h consumption monitor so finance can reassign if <50% used.

Omar (Billing): Monitor added: monitor.billing.pool.POOL-APR-26.consumed_pct < 50% over 48h -> notify #finance.

credits-bot: TRANSFER COMPLETE TR-APR-762. Allocations: benches/light-eval:500000, infra/temp:900000, teams/research:350000. Audit tag applied: POOL-APR-26

Leo (ML Eng): Kicking off evals now. Will report consumption numbers in FIN ticket.

Maya (Finance): Thanks all. Follow-up: add spend-plan requirement when accepting promo credits next quarter.
